items.title: Getting Started: build Compass
items.description: Build Compass on Copilotz 1.0: import the agentic core, rebuild Copilotz's other plugins for one person, one primitive at a time.

items.title: Ch 1: One agent, one message
items.description: A runtime, two of Copilotz's plugins and one of yours; the events a message leaves.

items.title: Ch 2: North, in your terminal
items.description: A plugin of your own, laid out by primitive; the prompt is a View.

items.title: Ch 3: Compass in the browser
items.description: Identity rebuilt for one person: a who, a route, a rule; the web page in Compass's look.

items.title: Ch 4: Today, every turn
items.description: A turn context: the prompt's stable part, the part that changes, and the cache.

items.title: Ch 5: One store
items.description: SQLite, the store's tables, each collection as a SQL view, and one writer.

items.title: Ch 6: Chats that name themselves
items.description: A Processor on another plugin's events, and a scripted model in its test.

items.title: Ch 7: Spaces
items.description: Rebuild a plugin others depend on, by its contract, with a parity test.

items.title: Ch 8: Spaces on the web
items.description: Web Views, and resource kinds as places other plugins plug in.

items.title: Ch 9: The board's data and Actions
items.description: Two collections that must agree, changed only through Actions, in transactions.

items.title: Ch 10: The board on screen
items.description: The same board as a web View and a terminal View, both live.

items.title: Ch 11: The board for North
items.description: Tools that call the same Actions people use, and read back as text.
